title: Check: Atomic Number and Mass Number

questions.stem: What does the atomic number of an element tell you?

options.text: The total number of protons and neutrons
The number of protons in the nucleus
The number of neutrons in the nucleus

questions.explanation: The atomic number (Z) is defined as the number of protons in the nucleus of an atom. It uniquely identifies the element and, in a neutral atom, also equals the number of electrons.

questions.stem: An atom is represented as 27/13 Al (mass number 27, atomic number 13). How many neutrons does it have?
questions.explanation: The number of neutrons is calculated as mass number minus atomic number: 27 - 13 = 14 neutrons. The mass number is the total of protons and neutrons, while the atomic number gives only the protons.
